title: Manual Evia data and more accurate mileage
details: Every field Milos normally receives from an Evia progress scan can now be entered or edited manually from the learner, review or observation screen
Manual Evia data covers course identity, dates, KSB or AC coverage, OTJ or GLH, targets, evidence counts, Coach activity, EPA practice, confidence, wellbeing and Symi attendance
Today is now shown with a blue outline in the home calendar so booking dots remain visible
Mileage now resolves the UK postcode before road routing and ignores older cached map matches after this update
The saved calendar booking address remains the source of truth for every visit and the saved base is automatically rechecked when mileage is recalculated
